//: THE SENATE AS A PLACE OF ACTION (GDD §6.1; GAP §10 item 2). These read SenateSystem's flags: motion_against_me (a censure or embargo of yours is on the docket), censured / recognised / levied / embargoed (a motion that touched you carried), motion_passed_mine / motion_failed_mine (your own motion was decided). They make the chamber personal: a whip at your door with coin, a censure to answer, a levy to pay or refuse.

effects.text: {self.name} took {whip.name}'s purse and promised a vote. Six credits, a friend in the chamber, and a story the benches will tell.
{self.name} wanted no coin from {whip.name} — a favour, to be named later. The whip agreed; whips always do.
{self.name} showed {whip.name} the door with the purse still in their hand. The vote stays the house's own.
{self.name} answered the motion from the floor, and the chamber went quiet to hear it. Whatever the vote, the Reach heard the house speak.
{self.name} spent the night calling in favours. Three houses that owed the house something remembered it before the vote.
{self.name} let the motion stand unanswered. Contempt is also an argument.
{self.name} bowed to the Senate's censure and said the words. The chamber likes a house that knows how to lose.
{self.name} tore the censure in half on the floor of the Senate. Half the chamber was appalled. The other half took notes.
{self.name} said nothing, and wrote down every house that voted for it.
{self.name} gave a feast for the houses that voted the recognition. Six credits, and a Senate that remembers the wine.
{self.name} accepted the recognition with a nod and went back to work. Standing is a thing you spend later.
{self.name} paid the Senate's levy and let the chair see it paid. A good subject, this season.
{self.name} paid, and spoke for an hour about the paying. The chamber remembered the speech longer than the coin.
{self.name} passed the levy down to the worlds as a tithe. The coin came back; the loyalty did not.
{self.name}'s motion carried, and {self.name} spent the evening making sure every house knew whose it had been.
{self.name}'s motion carried. {self.name} thanked the houses that opposed it for the quality of their opposition.
